questions.scenario: An adult patient arrives for a routine inactivated vaccine at a Massachusetts pharmacy. The appropriate Vaccine Information Statement (VIS) is available, and the screening, order, dose and personnel requirements are otherwise met. A technician suggests handing the patient the VIS at checkout immediately after the injection because the pharmacy will document the VIS edition date in the record.
questions.lead_in: What should the immunizing pharmacist do before administering the vaccine? Select ONE answer.

choices.text: Provide the appropriate current VIS to the patient or legal representative before vaccination.
choices.rationale_ko: 옳습니다. 관련 VIS를 실제 투여 전에 제공해야 하며, 나중에 기록하거나 post-visit에 전달하는 것은 해당 사전 제공 의무를 대신하지 않습니다.

choices.text: Administer the vaccine and provide the VIS only if the patient asks for it at checkout.
choices.rationale_ko: VIS는 요청 시 사후 제공만으로 대체하는 서류가 아닙니다. 주사 전 교부가 필요한 대상인지 확인해야 합니다.

choices.text: Use the pharmacy’s generic vaccine brochure instead of the applicable VIS because the product is routine.
choices.rationale_ko: 일반 brochure는 요구되는 제품별 VIS(해당되는 경우 별도 FDA/CDC Fact Sheet)를 대신하지 않습니다.

choices.text: Skip the VIS if the immunizing pharmacist has screened for allergies and contraindications.
choices.rationale_ko: 의학적 screening과 예방접종 전 정보 제공은 별개의 의무입니다.

authority: CDC Vaccine Information Statements; applicable federal law

questions.scenario: A Massachusetts community pharmacy administers an influenza vaccine to an established adult patient. The pharmacist knows that the policy's usual pre-administration MIIS look-up exception applies to influenza vaccination. The technician argues that, because no pre-vaccination MIIS search was required, this influenza dose does not need to be reported to MIIS.
questions.lead_in: Which response best distinguishes the two MIIS activities? Select ONE answer.

choices.text: The pre-administration MIIS look-up exception does not remove the required report of the administered influenza dose.
choices.rationale_ko: 옳습니다. 이전 투여기록을 투여 전에 조회하는 행위와 오늘 투여한 실제 dose를 지정된 기한 내 전송하는 의무는 서로 다른 법적 사건입니다.

choices.text: Neither a pre-administration MIIS search nor a post-administration report is needed for influenza vaccines.
choices.rationale_ko: 예외는 특정 사전조회 요건에 관한 것이며 MIIS의 의무 보고 전체를 없애지 않습니다.

choices.text: Reporting is required only if the influenza vaccine was ordered through CDTM rather than a standing order.
choices.rationale_ko: MIIS 보고 대상은 적법한 투여 행위 자체이며 standing order인지 CDTM인지로만 보고 의무를 결정하지 않습니다.

choices.text: The pharmacist may replace the MIIS dose report with a note in the pharmacy's local dispensing software.
choices.rationale_ko: 내부 기록과 주 MIIS 데이터 전송은 동일하지 않습니다.

questions.scenario: A pharmacist administers a routine vaccine at 9:00 AM Monday. The patient submits a completed MIIS data-sharing objection form at 3:00 PM that day. The pharmacy plans to upload the dose Friday morning and forward the objection form Wednesday afternoon, assuming both tasks have one shared deadline.
questions.lead_in: Which statement correctly applies the distinct reporting deadlines? Select ONE answer.

choices.text: Report the Monday administration to MIIS within 72 hours and transmit the objection form within 24 hours after its receipt.
choices.rationale_ko: 옳습니다. Vaccination submission은 administration 후 72시간, objection 전달은 수령 후 24시간입니다. 월요일 오전 9시 투여와 오후 3시 objection에 서로 다른 시작시각을 적용합니다.

choices.text: File both items by the end of the next calendar week because the patient's sharing preference is pending.
choices.rationale_ko: 환자 sharing preference가 미결이라고 보통의 immunization report를 다음 주까지 연기하는 일반 예외는 없습니다.

choices.text: Forward the objection form within 72 hours but submit the administered dose within 24 hours.
choices.rationale_ko: 두 별도 시계를 서로 바꿔 적용했습니다.

choices.text: Do not report the dose at all because an objection form was submitted before the scheduled MIIS upload.
choices.rationale_ko: Information sharing objection은 Department의 mandatory vaccination reporting 자체를 취소하지 않습니다.

questions.scenario: A patient who received a vaccine at a Massachusetts pharmacy signs a valid MIIS data-sharing objection form. Later, a pharmacist from an unrelated site opens the patient's immunization record solely out of curiosity. The pharmacy manager is reviewing what the objection changed and whether the access was justified.
questions.lead_in: Which statement best explains the two separate obligations? Select ONE answer.

choices.text: The administering site must still report the dose to MIIS, while the data-sharing objection and any inappropriate access must be handled under their separate rules.
choices.rationale_ko: 옳습니다. Mandatory reporting과 cross-site data sharing preference는 서로 다릅니다. 유효한 MIIS login이 업무 목적과 무관한 curiosity access를 정당화하지 않습니다.

choices.text: The signed objection form retroactively deletes the Department's mandatory record of the administered vaccine.
choices.rationale_ko: 정보공유 objection은 MIIS에 report하지 않아도 된다는 전면 면제가 아니며 관련 provider record 자체 삭제 명령도 아닙니다.

choices.text: Any licensed pharmacist may access any MIIS record for personal interest as long as their login is active.
choices.rationale_ko: 자격증·login은 업무와 무관한 개별 환자 기록의 임의 조회 권한을 부여하지 않습니다.

choices.text: The pharmacy should withhold all reporting until every other healthcare site acknowledges the objection.
choices.rationale_ko: Objection 처리와 statutory MIIS submission 의무를 혼합하거나 타기관 승인 대기로 보고를 중단하지 않습니다.
